How it works

01 / Pick the rules

One-step, two-step or end-of-day trailing, on a $5,000 to $100,000 account - the three shapes most crypto prop firms sell.

02 / Trade the terminal

Every position you open in the paper trading terminal from now on counts, with real fees and funding. Leverage above the rule and margin above your free balance are refused.

03 / Pass or learn

Hit the target on closed trades with the minimum trading days and no rule broken, and the run is certified. Break a rule and the run ends at that moment - start another one.

The rules, exactly as we score them

What counts. Every server-filled position you open after the challenge starts. Positions you already held are ignored, so a challenge always starts clean. Partial closes count when they close.

Daily loss. Measured from your closed balance at 00:00 UTC: your equity - closed balance plus the open profit and loss of your challenge positions - may not fall further below it than the daily limit, taken as a percentage of the account size. It resets every day and does not care how far ahead you were.

Maximum drawdown. Static sits at the account size minus the limit and never moves. Trailing rises with your highest closed balance. End-of-day trailing rises with your highest balance at the close of a UTC day. None of them ever move down.

When it is checked. Every close is checked the moment it lands. Open losses are checked every ten minutes and whenever you open the challenge in the terminal or here. A breach ends the run on the spot - a later recovery does not undo it, exactly as at a firm.

Passing. Your closed balance reaches the target and you have traded on at least the minimum number of days (a day with a challenge trade opened or closed). Two-step runs phase 2 from a fresh balance. A pass earns a certificate and 100 XP.

FAQ

Is the MarginPad prop firm challenge free?
Yes. There is no fee, no deposit and no card. You start a challenge on your free MarginPad account, trade it on live crypto prices in the paper-trading terminal, and the server scores it against the rules. You can retry as often as you like.
Do I get funded if I pass?
No - MarginPad does not fund traders and sells no challenges. A pass earns a certificate you can share and proves to yourself that you can hit a target without breaking the limits. Take that to a real prop firm only once you can do it repeatedly.
How is the daily loss limit measured?
From your closed balance at 00:00 UTC. Your equity - balance plus the open profit and loss of your challenge positions - may not fall more than the daily limit, as a percentage of the account size, below it. Closed trades are checked the moment they close; open losses are checked every ten minutes and whenever you open the challenge.
What counts as a challenge trade?
Every position you open in the MarginPad terminal (or through the Bot API) after the challenge starts. Positions you held before starting are ignored. Leverage above the rule set and margin above your free challenge balance are refused, as a real firm would refuse them.
What is the difference between the three rule sets?
One-step asks for 10% with a 4% daily limit and a 6% drawdown that trails your highest closed balance. Two-step splits the target into 8% and then 5% with a looser, static 10% drawdown. One-step EOD trails the drawdown from the highest end-of-day balance and caps leverage at 50x. Most real crypto prop firms use one of these shapes.
Which rule fails the most challenges?
The daily loss limit. Measured on our own traders, it ends far more runs than the overall drawdown, because it resets every day and ignores how far ahead you were. Size every trade so two full stops in a row still leave you trading tomorrow.
